name: Coordinate-Graded Yang Tor Algebra
definition: For the Yang complex $\Delta_C$ in the literal polynomial ring $S=k[x_{i,0},x_{i,1}]$, give both literals over coordinate $i$ degree $\mathbf e_i$ and take the homological, coordinate-graded Tor algebra, including its multiplication.
codomain: Homological and multigraded algebras over the coefficient field
parameters: A finite binary class $C$ and a coefficient field $k$.
normalization: The coordinate grading remembers the coordinate but forgets which of its two signed literals occurs.
comments: Its graded dimensions are the coordinate-graded Betti numbers of the Yang Stanley--Reisner ring.
